title: New Taliban-Pakistan Border Clash at Zakha Khel Bazaar, Khyber District
detail: A cross-border small-arms and artillery exchange broke out between Taliban and Pakistani forces near Zakha Khel Bazaar in Khyber district along the Durand Line on July 9, 2026. Neither Islamabad nor Kabul issued an official statement or casualty figures.

sources.name: Afghanistan International — Taliban, Pakistani Forces Clash Again Along Durand Line

media.caption: A cross-border clash between Taliban and Pakistani forces was reported near Zakha Khel Bazaar, Khyber district.
